<h>Hymnus</h>
<c>Æ</c>térne Rex altíssime,
Redémptor et fidélium,
Quo mors solúta déperit,
Datur triúmphum grátiæ.

<h>S</h>candens tribúnal déxteræ
Patris, potéstas ómnium
Colláta Iesu cǽlitus,
Quæ non erat humánitus:

<h>U</h>t trina rerum máchina,
Cæléstium, terréstrium,
Et inferórum cóndita,
Flectat genu iam súbdita.

<h>T</h>remunt vidéntes Angeli
Versam vicem mortálium:
Culpat caro, purgat caro,
Regnat Deus Dei caro.

<h>T</h>u esto nostrum gáudium,
Manens olýmpo prǽditum:
Mundi regis qui fábricam,
Mundána vincens gáudia.

<h>I</h>esu, tibi sit glória,
Qui victor in cælum redis,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
b.ae29f3b7d3:
<h>Hymn</h>
<c>E</c>ternal Monarch, King most high,
Whose blood hath brought redemption nigh,
By whom the death of death was wrought,
And conquering grace's battle fought:

<h>A</h>scending by the starry road,
This day thou wentest home to God,
By heaven to power unending called,
And by no human hand installed.

<h>T</h>hat so, in nature's triple frame,
Each heavenly and each earthly name,
And things in hell's abyss abhorred,
May bend the knee and own him Lord.

<h>Y</h>ea, angels tremble when they see
How changed is our humanity;
That flesh hath purged what flesh had stained,
And God, the flesh of God, hath reigned.

<h>B</h>e thou our joy, O mighty Lord,
As thou wilt be our great reward;
Earth's joys to thee are nothing worth,
Thou joy and crown of heaven and earth.

<h>A</h>ll glory, Lord, to thee we pay,
Ascending o'er the stars today;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

<h>Lectio 1</h>
De Actibus Apostolórum
<r>Act 4:23-26</r>
<n>23</n> Dimíssi (Petrus et Ioánnes) venérunt ad suos, et annuntiavérunt eis quanta ad eos príncipes sacerdótum et senióres dixíssent.
<n>24</n> Qui cum audíssent, unanímiter levavérunt vocem ad Deum, et dixérunt: Dómine, tu es qui fecísti cælum et terram, mare et ómnia quæ in eis sunt:
<n>25</n> Qui Spíritu Sancto per os patris nostri David púeri tui dixísti: Quare fremuérunt gentes, et pópuli meditáti sunt inánia?
<n>26</n> Astitérunt reges terræ, et príncipes convenérunt in unum advérsus Dóminum, et advérsus Christum eius.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Si enim non abíero, Paráclitus non véniet ad vos: si autem abíero, mittam eum ad vos: cum autem vénerit ille, docébit vos omnem veritátem,
* Allelúia.
<r>℣.</r> Non enim loquétur a semetípso: sed quæcúmque áudiet, loquétur: et quæ ventúra sunt, annuntiábit vobis.
<r>℟.</r> Allelúia.

b.f794e704c5:
<h>Capitulum Hymnus Versus</h>
<r>Act. 1:1-2</r>
<c>P</c>rimum quidem sermónem feci de ómnibus, o Theóphile, quæ cœpit Iesus fácere et docére usque in diem, qua præcípiens Apóstolis per Spíritum Sanctum, quos elégit, assúmptus est.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>Hymnus</r>
<c>T</c>u, Christe, nostrum gáudium,
Manens Olýmpo prǽditum:
Mundi regis qui fábricam,
Mundána vincens gáudia.

<h>H</h>inc te precántes quǽsumus,
Ignósce culpis ómnibus
Et corda sursum súbleva
Ad te supérna grátia.

<h>U</h>t cum repénte cœperis
Clarére nube Iúdicis,
Pœnas repéllas débitas,
Reddas corónas pérditas.

<h>T</h>u esto nostrum gáudium,
Qui es futúrus prǽmium:
Sit nostra in te glória,
Per cuncta semper sǽcula.

<h>G</h>lória tibi, Dómine,
Qui scandis supra sídera,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.

<r>℣.</r> A summo cœlo egréssio eius, allelúia.
<r>℟.</r> Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius, allelúia.
b.644108c367:
<h>Chapter Hymn Verse</h>
<r>Act. 1:1-2</r>
<c>T</c>he former treatise I made, O Theophilus, of all things which Jesus began to do and to teach, Until the day on which, giving commandments by the Holy Ghost to the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>Hymn</r>
<c>T</c>u, Christe, nostrum gáudium,
Manens Olýmpo prǽditum:
Mundi regis qui fábricam,
Overcoming the joys of the world.

Therefore we pray and beseech thee,
Forgive all our faults
Et corda sursum súbleva
To thee by heavenly grace.

<h>U</h>t cum repénte cœperis
To shine in the cloud of the Judge,
Mayest thou turn away the punishments we deserve,
And give back the crowns we have lost.

<h>T</h>u esto nostrum gáudium,
Thou who art to be our reward:
Sit nostra in te glória,
Per cuncta semper sǽcula.

Glory be to thee, O Lord,
Qui scandis supra sídera,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.

b.0ff25907c4:
<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>I</c>dibus Maii Luna nona. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>V</h>igília Pentecóstes.
<h>S</h>ancti Ioánnis Baptístæ de La Salle, Presbýteri et Confessóris, qui Sodalitátis Fratrum Scholárum Christianárum fuit Institútor, ac séptimo Idus Aprílis obdormívit in Dómino.
<h>I</h>n Hispánia sanctórum Torquáti, Ctesiphóntis, Secúndi, Indalétii, Cæcílii, Hesýchii et Euphrásii; qui Romæ a sanctis Apóstolis Epíscopi ordináti, et ad prædicándum verbum Dei in Hispánias dirécti sunt. Cum autem hi váriis úrbibus evangelizássent, et innúmeras multitúdines ad Christi fidem perduxíssent, divérsis in ea província locis quievérunt; scílicet Torquátus Acci, Ctésiphon Vérgii, Secúndus Abulæ, Indalétius Urci, Cæcílius Illíberi, Hesýchius Cartéiæ et Euphrásius Illitúrgi.
<h>F</h>ausínæ, in Sardínia, sancti Simplícii, Epíscopi et Mártyris, qui, Diocletiáni témpore, sub Bárbaro Prǽside, perfóssus láncea martýrium consummávit.
<h>E</h>boræ, in Lusitánia, sancti Máncii Mártyris.
<h>I</h>n ínsula Chio natális beáti Isidóri Mártyris, in cuius Basílica exstat púteus, in quem fertur fuísse iniéctus, de cuius aqua infírmi potáti sǽpius sanántur.
<h>L</h>ámpsaci, in Hellespónto, pássio sanctórum Petri, Andréæ, Pauli et Dionýsiæ.
<h>A</h>rvérnis, in Gállia, sanctórum Mártyrum Cássii, Victoríni, Máximi et Sociórum.
<h>G</h>helæ, in Brabántia, sanctæ Dympnæ, Vírginis et Mártyris, fíliæ Regis Hibernórum; quæ, cum in fide Christi et virginitáte servánda permanéret immóbilis, a patre iussa est decollári.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.d51b271b78:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>M</c>ay 15th 2027, the 9th day of the Moon,
<h>T</h>he Vigil of Pentecost.
<h>I</h>n Spain are commemorated the holy Bishops Torquatus, Ctesiphon, Secundus, Indaletius, Caecilius, Hesychius, and Euphratius. They were ordained at Rome by the holy Apostles, and sent to preach the Word of God in Spain. They evangelised diverse cities, and brought countless multitudes into the obedience of the faith of Christ, and fell asleep each in a different place in that land. Torquatus at Cadiz, Ctesiphon at Vierco, Secundus at Avila, Indaletius at Portilla, Caecilius at Elvira, Hesychius at Gibraltar, and Euphratius at Andujar.
<h>A</h>t Faustina, in Sardinia, the holy martyr Simplicius, Bishop [of that see,] who was thrust through with a lance, under the President Barbaros, in the time of the Emperor Diocletian, and so finished his testimony.
<h>A</h>t Evora, in Portugal, [in the sixth century,] the holy martyr Mancius.
<h>I</h>n the island of Chios, [in the year 251,] was born into the better life: the blessed martyr Isidore, whose church there is a well into the which he is said to have been cast, of the water whereof the sick oftentimes drink and are healed.
<h>A</h>t Lampsacus, on the Hellespont, [in the persecution under the Emperor Decius,] suffered the holy martyrs Peter, Andrew, Paul, and Dionysia.
<h>A</h>t Clermont, in Auvergne, [in the first century,] the holy martyrs Cassius, Victorinus, Maximus, and their Companions.
<h>I</h>n Brabant, the holy Virgin and martyr Dymphna, daughter of a King of Ireland, who was beheaded by order of her own father on account of her belief in Christ, and her holding to her virginity.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>Hymnus</r>
<c>Æ</c>térne Rex altíssime,
Redémptor et fidélium,
Quo mors solúta déperit,
Datur triúmphum grátiæ.

<h>S</h>candens tribúnal déxteræ
Patris, potéstas ómnium
Colláta Iesu cǽlitus,
Quæ non erat humánitus:

<h>U</h>t trina rerum máchina,
Cæléstium, terréstrium,
Et inferórum cóndita,
Flectat genu iam súbdita.

<h>T</h>remunt vidéntes Angeli
Versam vicem mortálium:
Culpat caro, purgat caro,
Regnat Deus Dei caro.

<h>T</h>u esto nostrum gáudium,
Manens olýmpo prǽditum:
Mundi regis qui fábricam,
Mundána vincens gáudia.

<h>I</h>esu, tibi sit glória,
Qui victor in cælum redis,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.

b.fa225fa155:
<h>Chapter Hymn Verse</h>
<r>Act. 1:1-2</r>
<c>T</c>he former treatise I made, O Theophilus, of all things which Jesus began to do and to teach, Until the day on which, giving commandments by the Holy Ghost to the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>Hymn</r>
<c>E</c>ternal Monarch, King most high,
Whose blood hath brought redemption nigh,
By whom the death of death was wrought,
And conquering grace's battle fought:

<h>A</h>scending by the starry road,
This day thou wentest home to God,
By heaven to power unending called,
And by no human hand installed.

<h>T</h>hat so, in nature's triple frame,
Each heavenly and each earthly name,
And things in hell's abyss abhorred,
May bend the knee and own him Lord.

<h>Y</h>ea, angels tremble when they see
How changed is our humanity;
That flesh hath purged what flesh had stained,
And God, the flesh of God, hath reigned.

<h>B</h>e thou our joy, O mighty Lord,
As thou wilt be our great reward;
Earth's joys to thee are nothing worth,
Thou joy and crown of heaven and earth.

<h>A</h>ll glory, Lord, to thee we pay,
Ascending o'er the stars today;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

b.dc739fa65c:
<h>Hymnus</h>
<c>I</c>esu nostra redémptio,
Amor et desidérium,
Deus Creátor ómnium,
Homo in fine témporum:

<h>Q</h>uæ te vicit cleméntia,
Ut ferres nostra crímina,
Crudélem mortem pátiens,
Ut nos a morte tólleres!

<h>I</h>nférni claustra pénetrans,
Tuos captívos rédimens,
Victor triúmpho nóbili
Ad dextram Patris résidens.

<h>I</h>psa te cogat píetas,
Ut mala nostra súperes
Parcéndo, et voti cómpotes
Nos tuo vultu sáties.

<h>T</h>u esto nostrum gáudium,
Qui es futúrus prǽmium,
Sit nostra in te glória,
Per cuncta semper sǽcula.

<h>G</h>lória tibi Dómine,
Qui scandis super sídera,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.

<r>℣.</r> Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi, allelúia.
<r>℟.</r> Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos, allelúia.
b.81fd451f3d:
<h>Hymn</h>
<c>H</c>ail, thou who man's Redeemer art,
Jesu, the joy of every heart;
Great Maker of the world's wide frame,
And purest love's delight and flame:

<h>W</h>hat nameless mercy thee o'ercame,
To bear our load of sin and shame?
For guiltless, thou thy life didst give,
That sinful erring man might live.

<h>T</h>he realms of woe are forced by thee,
Its captives from their chains set free;
And thou, amid thy ransomed train,
At God's right hand dost victor reign.

<h>L</h>et mercy sweet with thee prevail,
To cure the wounds we now bewail;
Oh, bless us with thy holy sight,
And fill us with eternal light.

<h>O</h>ur guide, our way to heavenly rest,
Be thou the aim of every breast;
Be thou the soother of our tears,
Our sweet reward above the spheres.

<h>A</h>ll glory, Lord, to Thee we pay,
Ascending o'er the stars to-day;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

<r>℣.</r> Keep us, Lord, as the apple of thine eye, alleluia.
<r>℟.</r> Protect us under the shadow of thy wings, alleluia.

b.3b7f3a5c9a:
<h>Oratio</h>
<r>℣.</r> Dóminus vobíscum.
<r>℟.</r> Et cum spíritu tuo.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>C</c>oncéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui hodiérna die Unigénitum tuum, Redemptórem nostrum, ad cælos ascendísse crédimus; ipsi quoque mente in cæléstibus habitémus.
<h>P</h>er eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.028980e72c:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> The Lord be with you.
<r>℟.</r> And with thy spirit.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>G</c>rant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that just as we do believe thine Only-Begotten Son, our Saviour, to have this day ascended into the heavens, so we may also in heart and mind thither ascend, and with Him continually dwell.
<h>T</h>hrough the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
